SELECT DOCUMENT_ID, DOCUMENT_NO, BUSINESS_DATE, PARTNER_ID, PARTNER_CODE, PARTNER_NAME, WAREHOUSE_ID, WAREHOUSE_CODE, WAREHOUSE_NAME, ASSIGNEE_ID, ASSIGNEE_CODE, ASSIGNEE_NAME, NOTE, PROGRESS_STATUS, ITEM_SUMMARY, TOTAL_AMOUNT, TOTAL_QUANTITY FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM rn, ordered_document.* FROM ( SELECT h.SALE_ID AS DOCUMENT_ID, h.SALE_NO AS DOCUMENT_NO, TO_CHAR(h.BUSINESS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BUSINESS_DATE, h.BUSINESS_DATE AS SORT_BUSINESS_DATE, h.PARTNER_ID, p.PARTNER_CODE, h.PARTNER_NAME, h.WAREHOUSE_ID, w.WAREHOUSE_CODE, h.WAREHOUSE_NAME, h.ASSIGNEE_ID, a.ASSIGNEE_CODE, h.ASSIGNEE_NAME, h.NOTE, h.PROGRESS_STATUS, (SELECT MIN(l.ITEM_NAME) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY l.SALE_LINE_ID) || CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 1 THEN ' 외 ' || TO_CHAR(COUNT(*) - 1) || '건' ELSE '' END FROM SALE_LINE l WHERE l.SALE_ID = h.SALE_ID AND l.DELETED_YN = 'N') AS ITEM_SUMMARY, (SELECT NVL(SUM(l.TOTAL_AMOUNT), 0) FROM SALE_LINE l WHERE l.SALE_ID = h.SALE_ID AND l.DELETED_YN = 'N') AS TOTAL_AMOUNT, (SELECT NVL(SUM(l.QUANTITY), 0) FROM SALE_LINE l WHERE l.SALE_ID = h.SALE_ID AND l.DELETED_YN = 'N') AS TOTAL_QUANTITY FROM SALE h LEFT JOIN BIZ_PARTNER p ON p.PARTNER_ID = h.PARTNER_ID LEFT JOIN WAREHOUSE w ON w.WAREHOUSE_ID = h.WAREHOUSE_ID LEFT JOIN ASSIGNEE a ON a.ASSIGNEE_ID = h.ASSIGNEE_ID
ORDER BY h.BUSINESS_DATE DESC, h.SALE_ID DESC ) ordered_document WHERE ROWNUM <= #{criteria.pageNum} * #{criteria.amount} ) WHERE rn > (#{criteria.pageNum} - 1) * #{criteria.amount} ORDER BY SORT_BUSINESS_DATE DESC, DOCUMENT_ID DESC

SELECT l.SALE_LINE_ID AS LINE_ID, l.ITEM_ID, i.ITEM_CODE, l.ITEM_NAME, l.SPECIFICATION, l.UNIT, l.QUANTITY, GREATEST(l.QUANTITY - NVL(( SELECT SUM(dl.QUANTITY) FROM SHIP_INSTRUCTION_LINE dl JOIN SHIP_INSTRUCTION dh ON dh.SHIP_INSTRUCTION_ID = dl.SHIP_INSTRUCTION_ID WHERE dl.SALE_LINE_ID = l.SALE_LINE_ID AND dl.DELETED_YN = 'N' AND dh.DELETED_YN = 'N' ), 0), 0) AS REMAINING_QUANTITY, l.UNIT_PRICE, l.SUPPLY_AMOUNT, l.VAT_AMOUNT, l.TOTAL_AMOUNT, l.NOTE FROM SALE_LINE l JOIN SALE h ON h.SALE_ID = l.SALE_ID LEFT JOIN ITEM i ON i.ITEM_ID = l.ITEM_ID WHERE l.SALE_ID = #{documentId} AND l.DELETED_YN = 'N' AND h.DELETED_YN = 'N' ORDER BY l.SALE_LINE_ID ASC
